study.title: Kathmandu Valley urban pilot, Nepal
study.question: Are matched-season Sentinel-2 pairs available over a bounded inner-city pilot, and does bare soil / construction confusion threaten a built-up signal?
limitations: Bare soil, construction sites and dry riverbeds mimic built-up spectra.
NDBI is a feature, not a building label.

properties.source: Manually placed; not a municipal boundary.

operations: STAC search per period with AOI polygon and bounded date range
in-AOI SCL valid-fraction scoring under a measurement budget
anchor-window observation selection, one scene per calendar date
bounded COG window reads via WarpedVRT (bilinear reflectance, nearest SCL)
per-item radiometry verification and DN->reflectance scaling
AOI + SCL + finite-reflectance masking, no interpolation
per-pixel temporal composite with valid-observation counts
spectral index computation on composite reflectance
shared-valid difference maps, candidate thresholds and projected areas
georeferenced raster, preview, JSON/CSV and manifest export
independent re-open and numerical verification of exports

parameters.composite_median_even_rule: NumPy nanmedian: mean of the two central values when the observation count is even
parameters.mask_policy: valid = inside AOI AND SCL class accepted AND every fetched reflectance band finite
parameters.area_convention: projected pixel area on the analysis grid; ha = m2/10000, km2 = m2/1000000

attribution.text: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data).
attribution.license: Copernicus Sentinel data: free, open and unrestricted use with attribution (ESA Copernicus data policy). Catalogue: Element 84 Earth Search, AWS Open Data.

limitations: Bare soil, construction sites and dry riverbeds mimic built-up spectra.
NDBI is a feature, not a building label.
The following indices use 20 m SWIR bands resampled to the 10 m analysis grid and contain no genuine 10 m SWIR detail: ndbi.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.
